scenarios.title: Work queue
scenarios.real: Order processing: 4 services publish durable 1 KiB jobs with confirms, 4 workers ack each one.

scenarios.title: Fire-and-forget telemetry
scenarios.real: Metrics and logs: 4 producers, no confirms, transient 256 B messages, auto-ack consumers.

scenarios.title: Broadcast to 20 services
scenarios.real: Domain events on a fanout exchange, each copied to 20 durable subscriber queues.

scenarios.title: 64 queues, own publisher each
scenarios.real: Per-tenant queues: 64 publishers and 64 consumers on a direct exchange, durable 512 B.

scenarios.title: 64 KiB messages
scenarios.real: Documents and images: 2 producers of durable 64 KiB bodies, scored in MB/s.

scenarios.title: 1 MiB messages
scenarios.real: Large payloads: 1 producer of durable 1 MiB bodies, 4 confirms in flight, scored in MB/s.

scenarios.title: Latency at 1,000 msg/s
scenarios.real: A steady API workload: 1,000 durable 1 KiB msg/s with confirms. Scored on end-to-end latency.

scenarios.title: Latency at 10,000 msg/s
scenarios.real: A busy API workload: 2 producers at 5,000 durable 1 KiB msg/s each.

scenarios.title: 500 queues, 1,000 connections
scenarios.real: Many small services: 500 queues, each with its own producer at 10 msg/s and its own consumer.

scenarios.title: Slow workers, prefetch 1
scenarios.real: 20 workers that each spend 2 ms per job with prefetch 1, fed 5,000 msg/s.

scenarios.title: Quorum queue
scenarios.real: The replicated queue type, here on one node: 4 producers, 4 consumers, durable 1 KiB.

scenarios.title: Stream queue
scenarios.real: An append-only log read by 2 consumers from the start, over AMQP 0-9-1.

scenarios.title: Priority queue
scenarios.real: x-max-priority=10, every message at priority 5, 2 producers and 2 consumers.

scenarios.title: Transactions
scenarios.real: tx.select publishers committing every 10 messages, transactional consumers acking every 10.

scenarios.title: Heavy mixed load
scenarios.real: 64 producers and 64 consumers across 16 durable queues, 200 confirms in flight each.

scenarios.title: Backlog fill and drain
scenarios.real: A consumer outage: 300,000 durable 1 KiB messages pile up, then 4 consumers drain them.
